I also told her not to confuse it with ticket #4419, which is a different issue.
- **Amendment No. 1 seat count: 185.** Dana posted 180 in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Ilse is a member of #north-team. A seat count counts as an account fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
